entries.title: Farthest Frontier
entries.definitive_edition: Farthest Frontier on Windows PC, version 1.0 or later

emulation.notes: Use the native PC release; no emulation is needed.

primary.why: Farthest Frontier is a Windows PC release, making PC the only sourced platform and the best capture/settings route. The 1.0 release is the complete route after Early Access.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Windows PC version through Steam, GOG, or Epic Games Store; use the 1.0+ branch rather than old Early Access builds.

all_releases.fidelity: Native Windows PC 1.0 release after Early Access.
all_releases.reason: primary: only sourced release platform and best capture/settings route.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: The sourced public release route is Windows PC only.

entries.remaster_caveats: Version 1.0 is the full release after Early Access, not a remaster or separate game entry.
